1. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Eligibility Criteria: This Bid is under PAC. The Tender has to be quoted by the OEM M/s Cummins India Limited or their Authori zed Dealers (non - exclusive / exclusive basis) for sale of Cummins Products (spares, recon engines, new e ngines, batteries) & also providing the service for the products manufactured and marketed by Cummins i n the Territory (Visakhpatnam) B. Scope of Supply: D- Checks spares as enlisted for Cummins Make Diesel Engine Model: KTA38G5 with St amford Alternator Model: HC1634Y2 The details of the Diesel Generator sets are: Engine Sl.Nos: 25374132 with Alternator Sl.Nos: N12A040783 Engine Sl.Nos: 25375660 with Alternator Sl.Nos: N12B051099 C. Terms and Conditions: 1. Delivery : 4 months/ 120 days from the date of Placement of Order 2. The quoted rates shall remain firm till the supply of item and no price variation will be admissible. 3. The Goods shall be delivered at BDL Vizag Unit. Freight Charges if any, will be paid by M/s BDL as applic able. 4. Payment terms : 100% payment within 30 days from the date of Final Acceptance of PO items. 5. "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier’s invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law" 6. Compliance statement to be provided along with bid documents. 7. Inspection Agency : BDL- QC/ BDL PED VU 8. The Bidder shall submit the OEM Authorization Certificate along with the Bid Documents. 9. Total Value wise Evaluation will be done and the Order will be placed on Overall L1 basis 10. The list of items which have to be returned/ exchanged shall be mentioned in the Bid documents

11. L.D. Clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to th e delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods/ service, withi n the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of penalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (inclu ding duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part there of, subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be bor ne by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor 12. Statutory Deductions viz., TDS against income tax as applicable will be deducted while releasing the p ayment. 13. AS 9100D Clause: •Supplier shall not supply non-conforming product against specification. •Supplier shall notify BDL of non-conforming processes, products or services and obtain approval for their disposition (i.e. rework, rejection etc.,). •Supplier shall notify BDL of changes to manufacturing processes, products or services including changes of their external providers or location of manufacture and obtain BDL approval. •Supplier shall retain the product related records (processes, quality records etc.,) up to 3years. •BDL, its customer and regulatory authorities having right of access to the applicable areas of all your facili ties, at any level of supply chain, involved in our order and all applicable records. •Supplier shall ensure that the persons carrying out the manufacturing of items under this purchase order be aware of product conformity requirements, product safety and importance of ethical behavior etc. •Wherever drawing revisions are applicable, old drawings are to be returned to BDL or to be destroyed wit h an intimation to BDL. •Wherever applicable, ESD controls to be followed for PCB and other electronics items. •In case of any corrective action plan against non-conforming product reported/identified at any stage the same shall be brought to the notice of BDL for approval before its implementation. •"Supplier shall not use any suspected/detected counterfeit parts" during any stage of manufacturing. •Counterfeit parts shall not be supplied to BDL. If any counterfeit parts are received, severe action shall b e initiated against the supplier. •Vendor shall comply ISO 14001:2015 EMS for the PO. 14. BDL will not acknowledge receipt of goods or service as a valid supply/ service, until all mandatory doc uments listed in purchase Order (e.g., inspection report, free issue material consumption report, warranty certificate, ePBG, GST invoice) are provided. A checklist of submitted documents is required with each sup ply. within the specified time limit mentioned in GST Law". 15. The bidder should submit the compliance statement for acceptance of attached specifications and all t erms & conditions as per the said bid. 16. The vendor participating in the tender should declare if demerged in the recent times, to declare the m erge, nature of demerger for the assessment of the credentials for acceptance of your quotations, falling o n which knowing of the demerger in the later stage by bdl, bdl will entitle the vendor for debarment. . 5. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods

7. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 8. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST.
